Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

APEX-Accounting · documents: The primary paper describes 42 accounting contributors, median 11 and mean 12.6 years of experience, constructing month-end-close work under U.S. GAAP accrual accounting.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-accounting.expert-construction

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Contributor experience is a creator report, not an employee count, professional credential audit or commercial supplier-delivery finding. Audit, tax, consolidation, multi-entity/currency and external reporting lie outside the measured task scope.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

APEX-Accounting · documents: The paper grades binary rubric criteria with a DeepSeek-v4-Flash judge calibrated against 1,687 majority-vote expert criterion labels from 120 trajectories.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-accounting.judge-and-reliability

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The reported calibration is sample-specific; it does not validate every judgment. The ten-task Harbor sample instead defaults to Gemini-3-Flash with a different template.

APEX-Accounting · access terms: The Harbor card states CC-BY-4.0, identifies three tightened rubric criteria, and supplies static accounting-system exports rather than the leaderboard accounting-software interface.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-accounting.sample-rights-and-differences

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The card concerns this hypothetical public sample and explicitly warns that its scores are not comparable to leaderboard scores; it does not grant rights to unreleased tasks or establish real client transactions.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

APEX-Accounting · documents: The paper selected eleven difficult worlds from a 599-candidate-task pool using frontier-model scores; the ten hardest worlds became the closed benchmark and the eleventh supplied the public development set. It removed 24 incomplete-information tasks.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-accounting.selection-and-scope-limits

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Selection depends on the filtering models and excludes refusal/clarification cases. This is a difficult accounting-workflow slice, not representative performance on all accounting work.

APEX-Accounting · documents: The currently captured official leaderboard describes 100 tasks and 1,475 criteria, whereas the primary paper, creator post and Harbor card describe 160 closed tasks.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-accounting.unresolved-version-counts

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • These conflicting source-version counts are preserved. The paper uses Mean Criteria@3 while the captured leaderboard calls k=4 canonical; no single reconciled count, metric or current leaderboard performance is asserted.
